messages.subject: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain fully flexible and look forward to building a great relationship together. Let us know if this works for you!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
Your rolling on-time delivery to 2026Q3 stands at 62.5% (sc:70240@2026Q3).
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hi! Thanks for the volume commitment. We don't share cost breakdowns, that's internal stuff. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I see the note on our delivery score, yeah we had a few hiccups but it's all sorted now.

If we do 35 days lead time, we have to run overtime and the price actually goes up. Let's stick to 52 days and I can drop the price to €31.00. Our current offer is a price of €34.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, at our standard terms with a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
